contexts.text: Those Angels who reject the more interior things were acting within me, namely, at the upper region of the palate, and were compelling me to think and speak according to their thoughts...
The reason they held the higher region of the palate, was that in that place corporeal things, such as the blood, ascend into the brain, and descend also there...
His inward quality is described by, he hides evil under his tongue, and keeps it within his palate ().
